_template.label: Agency / Freelancer
_template.description: Project ranges, process, portfolio, retainers — a small agency's shape.

business.about: Small senior team. We take a limited number of projects at a time.

crm.//: vipSpend: a customer who has spent this much (in business.currency) becomes vip automatically.

orderMessages.//: Edit freely. Placeholders: {first_name} {name} {id} {status} {total} {eta} {business}. Any status you leave out falls back to the built-in line in the customer's language.

orderReminders.//: Hours an unpaid order waits before each polite reminder. Env ORDER_REMINDER_HOURS / ORDER_REMINDER_SECOND_HOURS win over these.

items.name: Business website
items.description: design, build, SEO basics, contact form

policies.ownership: You own the code and accounts after final payment.
policies.support: Two weeks of free bug fixes; new features are quoted separately.
policies.timeline: Timelines start after the advance and after content is received.

faqs.q: How much does a website cost?
faqs.a: Most business sites land between 60,000 and 180,000 PKR depending on pages and features.
10–21 days for a business site, longer for stores and apps.

faqs.q: What do you need from me to start?
faqs.a: Your logo, content and a reference site you like — then we begin.

tone.style: confident and human, no sales voice

goals.primary: get to a scoped quote or a call
goals.target: quote sent with scope and timeline

escalation.when: legal/contract questions, or a project above 500,000 PKR

agents.name: Discovery & Quote
agents.instructions: Qualify the goal, the scope and the budget, then send the quote built from the configured service list. One question at a time.
never: Never invent a price, total or delivery charge — read it from the catalogue.
Never approve a discount. Say the owner decides and hand off.
Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never promise returns, profits or "guaranteed" anything.

agents.name: Project Status
agents.persona: Precise, uses dates from the record only.
agents.instructions: Report the milestone and the date that is in the project record. If there is no record, say so and hand off rather than estimating.
never: Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never invent scarcity ("only 2 left") or urgency ("today only").

agents.name: Support
agents.instructions: Triage: what page, what happened, when. Hand off anything that needs a developer, and never promise a fix time.
never: Never claim to be a human when asked directly.
Never invent scarcity ("only 2 left") or urgency ("today only").

marketing._help: Marketing team settings. approvalMode true means every promo waits for you. events are your own dates: [{ "name": "Shop anniversary", "date": "2026-03-01" }]. channels are where your posters/QRs live: ["Instagram", "shop window"].
